title: Mamuju language - Wikipedia
text: Mamuju is an Austronesian language spoken on the island of Sulawesi in Indonesia. [2] The dialects of Mamuju include Mamuju, Sumare-Rangas, Padang, and Sinyonyoi. The Mamuju dialect is considered more prestigious. Its written form is based on Latin alphabet. [3] Although Mamuju is traditionally classified as South Sulawesi, it has various words of Wotu-Wolio origin. [4]
